description: Upload a picture or video you made (or a logo) and get its public URL, to use in a post's media or in a template variable. Send it as base64 or a data: URL with a filename that carries its extension (jpg, png, gif, webp, mp4, mov). purpose='brand' is for a logo or picture placed INSIDE a design (PNG, JPG or WebP, 2 MB). The server checks the bytes match the extension. Writes a file; creates no post.

data.description: The file as base64, or a data: URL (data:image/png;base64,...).

filename.description: Name with extension, e.g. card.png (needed unless data is a data: URL).

purpose.description: 'brand' for a logo or a picture placed inside a design.

name: viralhunt_upload_media
